text:
sarah: Quick heads-up — CloudVendor SI wants a coordinated launch for their marketplace listing + our KMS/HSM connector. They want SSO (SAML) + SCIM user sync + BYOK KMS flow to be demo-ready for partners on 2026-04-12. Can engineering confirm feasibility and blocking risks?

tom: Ack. Is the launch gated on marketplace listing approval or on connector GA?

marco: Marketing/partner ops prefer a single go-live date (marketplace + press). Legal needs to sign off on the joint PR language.

priya: From eng: SAML + SCIM is doable. Main items: claim mappings for group -> role, SCIM Rate limits (we should shard if they hit >50 req/s), and SCIM bulk replace semantics differ across IdPs. Also need to test with Azure AD + Okta + OneLogin.

lauren: Security checklist: HSM attestation + PKCS#11 compatibility for BYOK, clear KMIP path for on-prem KMS, and ensure audit logging is captured in the private deployment. Also need threat model sign-off for cross-account key import.

tom: Ops note: marketplace listing requires screenshots, an integration guide, and SSO quickstart. Can we reuse the conf snippet from the internal demo?

priya: I'll add a small test harness for SCIM + SAML. Quick example to exercise SCIM create + group membership: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://scim.cloudvendor.example/Users" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" -d '{"userName": "jdoe@example.com", "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Doe"}, "groups": [{"value": "eng"}] }'
```
This will expose any claim mapping mismatches quickly.

marco: Partner asked for a joint webinar week-of-04-19. If we ship on 04-12, gives a week for internal docs + PR. Is that timeline safe?

sarah: @priya @lauren please call out any hard blockers by EOD tomorrow. I'll coordinate press/marketplace checklist. Marco — capture webinar ask and we'll slot it once we confirm date.

lauren: Two potential blockers: (1) BYOK key import flow needs HSM attestation doc from CloudVendor (they promised this week) and (2) SCIM provisioning audit trail has gaps for group deltas; I'll open GH issues.

priya: Noted. If attestation doc lands, we can complete BYOK flow validation in 3 days. Otherwise add 7 days. SCIM delta audit fix is small but needs a test matrix against Okta/AD.

integrations-bot: Reminder: playbook template assigned to @priya (due 3891234720).

marco: I'll sync with partner PM on attestation ETA and ask for a machine-parsable statement. Also prepping co-branded screenshots.

tom: I'll start a lightweight marketplace draft (screenshots + quickstart) and link here. Iterations welcome.

sarah: Perfect. Action items: 
- priya: SCIM/SAML test harness + playbook (due 3891234720)
- lauren: security gating doc + GH issues
- tom: marketplace draft + screenshots
- marco: partner comms + attestation ETA
I’ll loop in legal for PR language. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
